1  ADVOCATE FOR THE PETITIONER, PRAYING TO, ENLARGE  THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF ARREST IN  CRIME NO.49/2023 OF KALABURAGI CITY WOMEN POLICE  STATION, DIST. KALABURAGI FOR THE OFFENCES  -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-K:1281  CRL.P No. 200635 of 2023 PUNISHABLE U/SEC.498(A), 323, 324, 355, 504, 506, 307 R/W SEC. 34 OF IPC AND U/SEC. 3, 4 OF DOWRY PROHIBITION ACT, 1961, PENDING BEFORE III ADDL.
DIST .
AND SESSIONS JUDGE AT KALABURAGI.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner along with the other accused is sought to be prosecuted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 355, 504, 506, 307 R/w Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, alleging that, accused No.1 along with the other accused subjected the informant to cruelty both physically and mentally and also demand was made to bring money from the parental home.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent- State.
3.

Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned HCGP for the respondent, on a cursory glance of complaint and other available material on record, more particularly, the investigation papers, it could be seen that except the vague omnibus allegations made against the petitioner in respect of dowry demand, there is no specific NC: 2023:KHC-K:1281 allegation in respect of the alleged offence under Section 307 of IPC.
Hence, the petitioner has made out a prima facie case to enlarge him on bail.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER
The petition filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. is allowed.

iv) He shall not threaten the prosecution witnesses.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER
The petition filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. is allowed.
Consequently, the petitioner-accused No.1 is directed to be released on anticipatory bail in the event of his arrest by respondent-police in connection with Crime No.49/2023 subject to the following conditions:
i) The petitioner shall execute personal bond for a sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer;
ii) He shall surrender himself before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer and appear before him as and when required.
Liberty is reserved with the prosecution or the victim to file an application for cancellation of the bail, in the event of violation of any of the conditions imposed herein.
